entries.title: Primary platform: paper
entries.content: Detected paper (95%: src/main/resources/plugin.yml, paper-api dependency); resourcepack (90%: resourcepack/pack.mcmeta). Minecraft version: 1.21.11.

entries.title: Default namespace "reactor"
entries.content: New resource locations, sound events and item models use this namespace unless the user says otherwise.

entries.title: Texture resolution 16x16
entries.content: Most existing textures are 16x16. New textures must match unless the user asks for a different resolution.

entries.title: Display-entity rig for machines
entries.content: Java block models cannot animate: reactor parts (core, rotor, lamp) are separate item models shown by ItemDisplay entities and animated from code with Transformation interpolation. Animations are authored on reactor_rig for review.

entries.title: Adaptive music: calm ↔ alarm
entries.content: calm 92 BPM D minor, alarm 132 BPM D minor (shared key). Transitions every 2 bars from loop start; loops re-triggered by metadata duration.

entries.title: Station AI voice
entries.content: Russian PA announcer: cold, calm, restrained, pace 0.92, PA-speaker processing, −18 LUFS. Pronunciation dictionary holds stresses for реактор/активной/мощность/заглушен.

entries.title: Reactor states
entries.content: OFF → STARTING (startup timeline) → RUNNING → WARNING (heat ≥ 70) → CRITICAL (≥ 90) → FAILED (100, visual explosion only). SCRAM from any active state → SHUTTING_DOWN → OFF. Media per state: core texture off/active/warning/critical, lamp off/on blinking, engine loop, alarm beep (warning), siren (critical), calm/alarm music.

entries.title: Paper 1.21.11 / Java 21
entries.content: paper-api 1.21.11-R0.1-SNAPSHOT (last pre-26.x version; 26.x needs Java 25 and build versions). Item models via ItemMeta#setItemModel + assets/<ns>/items/<id>.json; resource pack format 75.

entries.title: Style profile "default"
entries.content: restrained palette (~5.5 colours per 16×16); high contrast (L* range 51.55); muted colours; noisy material surfaces (noise 10.985); little or no dithering; highlights shift -6.55° in hue from shadows; no distinct outline; chunky pixel clusters (mean 10.875 px). Pixel density 16x16. Lighting bottom-right.
